name: dev.turbostarter/docs
title: TurboStarter Docs MCP
description: Search and read the TurboStarter starter kit docs from any MCP client.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search TurboStarter documentation across every product. Returns ranked hits with URLs and snippets. Prefer short queries of 2-5 words for one concept; long keyword dumps often return no results.

query.description: Short search query of 2-5 words for one concept (e.g. 'dark mode', 'billing stripe'). Do not stuff synonyms or the full question into one query.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: Read a TurboStarter documentation page as markdown.
